result.title: Allocate a budget across options
result.doc:
Split a budget across options with diminishing returns.
Input: {"budget": int, "options": [{"id": str, "kind": str, "a": number, "b": number, "cost": int, "cap": int}, ...]}.
Output: {"units": [integer units bought of every option, in order]} with 0 <= units <= cap and sum(units x cost) <= budget.
Return of an option by kind: log: a x ln(1 + b x units); root: a x sqrt(b x units); sat: a x (1 - exp(-b x units)).
In this world unit costs range from 1 to 3 and caps from 3 to 9.
Score: your total return / the optimal total return; 0 if over budget or over a cap.

result.title: Normalise records from partner feeds
result.doc:
Normalise records that arrive in this world's wire formats.
Input: {"rows": [{"src": str, "data": <raw record>}, ...]}. `src` names the feed a row came from; every feed has its own wire format (how a record is laid out, how field names, value types and values are written). The wire formats are not documented.
Output: {"records": [one object per row, in order]} - the normalised record: lowercase field names; values typed as string, integer, number, boolean, ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or null.
Score: the fraction of fields decoded exactly (name, type and value); extra fields count against you.
Published worked examples show raw rows with their correct normalised records.
